Same tool-selection question, but routed through the NATIVE SSE flow instead of the OpenAI-compatible endpoint. This is Phase 0's central experiment made executable: the documented SSE event types are content/done/sync/error only, so this case should come back BLOCKED, not a false PASS — proving the harness refuses to grade past evidence it doesn't actually have. Uses the granular `requiresEvidence` gate (evidence matrix) instead of the older whole-response `evidenceGradeRequired`, so the BLOCKED reason names the exact field (toolName) that fell short, not just an overall grade.
